description: Sabaragamuwa Province - Retired Judicial officer Hon. Saman Wickrama Wickramarachchi appointed as a Single Person Tribunal of inqure the functions of the Chairman of the Embilipitiya U/C. Temporarily suspend with immediate effect the Chairman of the Embilipitiya U/C
categorisation: This gazette contains both specific personnel appointments (naming Maheepala Herath, Hon. Saman Wickrama Wickramarachchi, Ven. Vewelduwe Gnanaprabha Thero, and Mr. W. G. Lalith Dharmakeerthi) AND detailed descriptions of their responsibilities and portfolios. The Chief Minister is explicitly identified with his full ministerial portfolio list, and the document outlines specific powers and duties being assigned to individuals under specific legal provisions, making this a Hybrid gazette (Type 3).
